caption: The drawing features three outlined views of a decorative object, all centered on a light beige background. At the top of the composition is a detailed, colored rendering of the object, which appears to be a shield-like or crest-shaped form with a symmetrical design, incorporating a frame outlined in dark gray and brown tones. The interior is segmented into geometric sections bordered by black lines, and there are ribbed, semi-circular accents in black and white at the top and bottom center of the frame. Below the colored view, there are two line drawings: one shows a top-down perspective similar to the colored version, and the other shows a side profile of the object. These two lower views are drawn in fine pencil lines only, without any coloration or shading. The overall arrangement places the colored view above and the two pencil outlines directly below, with the artist's name, "John Dieterich," written in the lower left corner.
title: Shoe Buckles
